bundled.name: SQLite and its JDBC bridge
bundled.why: sqlite-jdbc's JNI code is Apache 2.0; the SQLite it compiles in is public domain.

bundled.name: libremidi
bundled.why: libremidi's LICENSE.md: new code BSD 2-Clause, the parts derived from RtMidi under RtMidi's MIT licence and from ModernMidi under the BSD 2-Clause. It links the system's libjack.so.0 and loads its libasound.so.2 at run time, and defines none of their symbols, so neither JACK nor ALSA is bundled.

bundled.name: alsa-javacpp's JNI bindings
bundled.why: The JNI bindings JavaCPP generates for ALSA's API. They link the system's libasound.so.2 and define none of its symbols, so ALSA (LGPL) is not bundled.

bundled.name: CoreMIDI4J's native library
bundled.why: Ships inside the coremidi4j jar under the jar's own licence, used unmodified.

bundled.name: JNA's native dispatch library
bundled.why: jnidispatch is JNA's own code, dual-licensed and taken under the Apache 2.0, with libffi (MIT) compiled in.

bundled.name: jkeychain's macOS keychain bridge
bundled.where: osxkeychain.so at the root of lighting7.jar, from pt.davidafsilva.apple:jkeychain
bundled.why: Ships inside the jkeychain jar under the jar's own licence (its META-INF/LICENSE.txt).

bundled.name: lz4-java's native library
bundled.why: lz4-java is Apache 2.0; the LZ4 C library compiled into its native is BSD 2-Clause. Not in shadowJar's nativePayloads table, so every OS's jar carries all of it.

bundled.name: Jansi's native library
bundled.why: Jansi is Apache 2.0. Not in shadowJar's nativePayloads table, so every OS's jar carries all of it.

bundled.name: react-kotlin-playground, modified
bundled.where: frontend/src/kotlinScript/, compiled into the web UI's script editor
bundled.why: A modified copy of react-kotlin-playground 0.1.0-beta.14 (github.com/zoobestik/react-kotlin-playground, Copyright (c) 2020 kb.chernenko), the React wrapper for the kotlin-playground widget. Its LICENSE is kept beside it.

bundled.name: shadcn/ui components
bundled.where: frontend/src/components/ui/ (all but form-fields.tsx), compiled into the web UI
bundled.why: Generated by the shadcn CLI (frontend/components.json) from shadcn/ui's registry (github.com/shadcn-ui/ui, Copyright (c) 2023 shadcn) and edited since. Its LICENSE.md is kept beside them.

bundled.name: Gradle wrapper
bundled.where: gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar, in the source tree only
bundled.why: Vendored build tooling; never shipped in a jar or an installer.
